source_families.cadence: Weekly full Sunday 07:00 UTC; daily changes 07:00 UTC
Monthly close day 5 08:00 UTC; replacement corrections with new vintage
Original December 15 before plan year; midyear revision July 1 in 2024/2025
Quarterly first business day, next 3 target months only
Event occurrence plus simulated source/delivery delay; historical bounded replay

source_transform_policy: Resolve ID references through typed source_key_map at valid+knowledge time; parse UTC/date/decimals exactly; unknown mappings quarantine. No guessed identifiers.
wide_and_variance_policy: Unpivot wide period columns into counted scalar canonical rows. Variance-only fields are reconciled/recomputed, never added as actuals. Mapping exports populate source_key_map/cost_center/catalog_item, not hidden tables.

faults.action: deduplicate exact event/version, no economic/state change
retain availability; reproject affected period/bed if beyond normal lateness
mark partition incomplete, block certified close; never silently fill zero
quarantine incompatible layout; compatible additive fields handled only through versioned contract
quarantine scoped rows; record missing key and block dependent totals
replace exact source scope/vintage, retain prior knowledge history; no double add
reject/quarantine with row evidence; manifest fails until corrected
